text: Ball seirc is an Irish mythological motif. The Irish name means a love spot or a blemish on the skin. The handsome hero Diarmait bore the mark, and his full name was Diarmait Ua Duibne. The spot sat on his forehead, and at times on his shoulder. Every woman who saw the spot desired him. He hid it beneath a fringe of hair or a cap to live in peace. While he fought a pack of dogs the mark came into view. Grainne spied it in that moment and loved him at once. She then tricked Diarmait into fleeing with her.
